    Bug 2006174 - Attempt to fix tests by suppressing the know-your-rights notification. r=tobyp
    
    This is an attempt, which seemed to have worked well for WebExtension tests.
    In the test-fail-screenshots I have checked, the notification had focus, which
    could have unwanted side-effects (some have an empty open context menu).
    
    /mail/components/addrbook/test/browser/
    * https://treeherder.mozilla.org/jobs?repo=comm-central&revision=8bf2d3493643c075acd5013f72a4eeecc652b43d&selectedTaskRun=ZY6TkAAySaSo6U3fyUY6bw.0
